title: Cinematic split-light eyes portrait
reference_style: Intimate close-up with a horizontal eye strip, handwritten title and dramatic chiaroscuro.

reverse_engineered_prompt.concept: Moody fine-art beauty portrait using a horizontal split-light band to isolate and emphasize the eyes.

subject.expression: Quiet, introspective gaze directly toward camera, lips slightly parted
subject.hair: Long auburn-brown hair with soft fringe framing the face
subject.accessories: Fine silver chain necklace with a small oval pendant

composition.face_position: Face fills most of frame, slightly right of center
composition.signature_effect: A narrow horizontal rectangular band of warm light crosses both eyes, while the rest of the face remains in deeper shadow
composition.text_overlay: Small elegant handwritten script reading 'Those eyes' placed across the lit band

lighting.key: Hard-edged narrow strip light or projection across eye region
lighting.shadow: Deep chiaroscuro around cheeks, jaw and hair
lighting.texture: Natural pores, fine hair detail and realistic skin highlights

camera.focus: Critical sharp focus on both eyes and eyelashes

post_processing.color_grade: Warm bronze skin highlights against deep neutral blacks
post_processing.retouching: Minimal editorial retouching preserving pores and fine texture
post_processing.composite: Precisely masked horizontal light band with clean rectangular edges and subtle film grain
post_processing.finish: Cinematic luxury fragrance or music single artwork

reverse_engineered_prompt.negative_prompt: No crossed eyes, asymmetrical pupils, plastic skin, over-smoothed texture, extra facial features, illegible script, watermark.
